title: IS THE LORD AMONG US OR NOT?

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text:
"And he called the place Massah and Meribah because the Israelites quarreled and
because they tested the LORD saying, 'Is the LORD among us or not?'"
- Ex 17:7 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Here is the question underneath everything: "Is the LORD among us or not?"

Consider what makes it so strange. A pillar of cloud stood over them by day and
fire by night. They had eaten manna that morning. And still they asked whether
God was with them.

The problem was not lack of evidence. It was that the evidence did not match the
circumstance in front of them. They had God's presence and no water, and they
could not hold both at once.

We do the same. We know God has been faithful, and yet the current difficulty
raises the old question again. Where are You? Are You actually here?

Notice that Scripture records this question without embarrassment. It is asked
honestly. And notice that God answers it not with a lecture but with water.

The names stuck: Massah means testing, Meribah means quarrelling. Israel named a
place after their own failure, and the name became a warning for generations
(Ps 95:8-9; Heb 3:8).

But here is the answer to their question, and it is the whole point. God was
among them. He was standing on the rock.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What circumstance is making you ask whether God is really with you?
2. What evidence of His presence are you overlooking?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Father, when my situation makes me doubt Your presence, remind me of what is
already true. You are with me. Amen.
